blockbuilder.visual_critic_note: Intentional dark theme with consistent blue accent and clean grid layout show real design choices, but the color-usage scatter panel is nearly unreadable at render size due to overlapping sub-pixel dots, and typographic hierarchy is too flat to elevate it further.
blockbuilder.encoding_integrity_note: Strong encoding integrity: scaleSqrt used correctly for all bubble/node sizing, zero-based Y domain on the bar chart, data-driven domains via d3.extent/d3.max throughout, and time-binning uses utcMonth (data-aware) rather than arbitrary thresholds — no dual-axis, no silent-gap risk, no radius deception.
blockbuilder.stress_test_note: RAF dirty-flag pattern correctly coalesces renders, but both brush handlers run O(n) BitFilter bitmask computation and color-point iteration unthrottled on every mousemove; no transition races, no feedback loops, no touch-mouse fight (pointer events used), minor stale-scale risk on resize with no resize handler.
blockbuilder.cognitive_load_note: Four linked crossfilter views execute cleanly — consistent single-color palette, pre-computed (non-animating) network, and dirty-flag rendering keep the 60-node graph and color scatter readable, though the hue×lightness scatter is inherently dense and loses individual dot discernibility at smaller panel sizes.
